Recheck both the\n# directory and the held inode after flock: a removed/reinstalled path is not\n# the same installation, even when it contains identical package bytes.\nlifecycle_lock() {\n    [ -d \"$ROOT\" ] && [ ! -L \"$ROOT\" ] && [ \"$(readlink -f \"$ROOT\")\" = \"$ROOT\" ] && [ \"$(stat -c %u \"$ROOT\")\" = 0 ] || { echo 'Installation is absent or unsafe' >&2; exit 8; }\n    [ -f \"$ROOT/.topflow-install\" ] && [ ! -L \"$ROOT/.topflow-install\" ] || { echo 'Installation ownership is absent' >&2; exit 8; }\n    lifecycle_root=$(stat -c '%d:%i' \"$ROOT\") || exit 8\n    lifecycle_marker=$(cat \"$ROOT/.topflow-install\") || exit 8\n    [ -f \"$ROOT/.lifecycle.lock\" ] && [ ! -L \"$ROOT/.lifecycle.lock\" ] && [ \"$(stat -c %h \"$ROOT/.lifecycle.lock\")\" = 1 ] && [ \"$(stat -c %u \"$ROOT/.lifecycle.lock\")\" = 0 ] || { echo 'Installation lock is absent or unsafe' >&2; exit 8; }\n    if [ \"${1:-}\" !=",

A ten-second lease expires even if both custom processes die.\n# Never release ",
"the original global/internal locks or scan for prefix matches.\nguard_name() {\n    case \"${1:-}:${2:-}\" in *[!0-9:]*) return 1;; esac\n    [ -n \"${1:-}\" ] && [ -n \"${2:-}\" ] && [ \"$1\" -gt 1 ] && [ \"$2\" -gt 0 ] || return 1\n    printf 'topflow_screen_%s_%s\\n' \"$1\" \"$2\"\n}\nguard_io_safe() {\n    for guard_path in /sys/power/wake_lock /sys/power/wake_unlock; do\n        [ -f \"$guard_path\" ] && [ ! -L \"$guard_path\" ] && [ -w \"$guard_path\" ] || return 1\n    done\n    [ -r /sys/power/wake_lock ]\n}\nguard_active_io() { cat /sys/power/wake_lock; }\nguard_acquire_io() { printf '%s 10000000000\\n' \"$1\" > /sys/power/wake_lock; }\nguard_release_io() { printf '%s\\n' \"$1\" > /sys/power/wake_unlock; }\n# END GUARD_IO\nguard_observe() {\n    guard_active=$(guard_active_io) || return 2\n    printf '%s\\n' \"$guard_active\" | awk -v own=\"$1\" '{ for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i==own) found=1 } END { exit found ? 0 : 1 }'\n}\nguard_release() {\n    guard_io_safe || return 1\n    guard_result=0; guard_observe \"$1\" || guard_result=$?\n    [ \"$guard_result\" != 2 ",

/* source: manager-theme.js */
(function (root, factory) {
  if (typeof module === 'object' && module.exports) module.exports = factory();
  else root.TopFlowManagerTheme = factory();
})(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : this, function () {
  'use strict';

  var attributes = ['class', 'style', 'data-theme', 'data-bs-theme'];

  function computed(root, element) {
    if (!element || !root || typeof root.getComputedStyle !== 'function') return null;
    try { return root.getComputedStyle(element); } catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  function property(style, name) {
    if (!style || typeof style.getPropertyValue !== 'function') return '';
    return String(style.getPropertyValue(name) || '').trim();
  }

  // Browser-computed colors resolve UFI's hex/HSL/custom-property declarations.
  // Do not interpret the name "dark" in a host token as a theme selection.
  function color(value) {
    var match = /^rgba?\(\s*([\d.]+)(%?)\s*[, ]\s*([\d.]+)(%?)\s*[, ]\s*([\d.]+)(%?)(?:\s*[,/]\s*([\d.]+)(%?))?\s*\)$/i.exec(String(value || '').trim());
    if (!match) return null;
    var rgb = [1, 3, 5].map(function (index) {
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Number(match[index]) * (match[index + 1] ? 2.55 : 1)));
    });
    rgb.push(match[7] == null ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(match[7]) / (match[8] ? 100 : 1))));
    return rgb;
  }

  function luminance(rgb) {
    var linear = rgb.slice(0, 3).map(function (channel) {
      var value = channel / 255;
      return value <= 0.04045 ? value / 12.92 : Math.pow((value + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
    });
    return linear[0] * 0.2126 + linear[1] * 0.7152 + linear[2] * 0.0722;
  }

  function surface(background, behind) {
    if (background && background[3] >= 0.999) return background;
    if (!behind || behind[3] < 0.999) return null;
    if (!background) return behind;
    return background.slice(0, 3).map(function (channel, index) {
      return channel * background[3] + behind[index] * (1 - background[3]);
    }).concat(1);
  }

  function explicit(element) {
    if (!element) return '';
    var names = ['data-theme', 'data-bs-theme'];
    if (typeof element.getAttribute === 'function') {
      for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
        var value = String(element.getAttribute(names[i]) || '').toLowerCase();
        if (value === 'dark' || value === 'light') return value;
      }
    }
    var classes = ' ' + String(element.className || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ') + ' ';
    if (/ (?:dark|dark-mode) /.test(classes)) return 'dark';
    if (/ (?:light|light-mode) /.test(classes)) return 'light';
    return '';
  }

  function appearance(body, html) {
    var background = surface(color(body && body.backgroundColor), color(html && html.backgroundColor));
    if (background) return luminance(background) < 0.179 ? 'dark' : 'light';
    // A transparent host may sit over wallpaper. Use the host's resolved text
    // color as its readability choice, without introducing a separate theme.
    var foreground = color(body && body.color) || color(html && html.color);
    return foreground && foreground[3] > 0 ? (luminance(foreground) >= 0.179 ? 'dark' : 'light') : '';
  }

  function read(root, doc) {
    doc = doc || root && root.document || {};
    var body = computed(root, doc.body), html = computed(root, doc.documentElement);
    var host = property(body, '--dark-bg-color') || property(body, '--dark-text-color') ||
      property(html, '--dark-bg-color') || property(html, '--dark-text-color');
    var resolved = appearance(body, html);
    if (host && resolved) return resolved;
    var selected = explicit(doc.body) || explicit(doc.documentElement);
    if (selected) return selected;
    return resolved || 'light';
  }

  function watch(root, doc, callback) {
    doc = doc || root && root.document || {};
    var disposed = false, last = '', observer = null;
    function update() {
      if (disposed) return;
      var next = read(root, doc);
      if (next !== last) { last = next; callback(next); }
    }
    if (root && typeof root.MutationObserver === 'function') {
      observer = new root.MutationObserver(update);
      if (doc.documentElement) observer.observe(doc.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: attributes.slice() });
      if (doc.body && doc.body !== doc.documentElement) observer.observe(doc.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: attributes.slice() });
    }
    update();
    return function () {
      if (disposed) return;
      disposed = true;
      if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    };
  }

  return { read: read, watch: watch };
});

(function (root, factory) {

          });
        }

        syncTheme();

        doc.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true); doc.addEventListener('focusin', onFocus, true);
        // UFI uses a container-query root; mounting there would constrain fixed positioning.
        doc.body.appendChild(overlay); focus(cancel);

    }

/* source: manager-wallpaper.js */
(function (root, factory) {
  if (typeof module === 'object' && module.exports) module.exports = factory();
  else root.TopFlowManagerWallpaper = factory();
})(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : this, function () {
  'use strict';

  var WIDTH = 320, HEIGHT = 480, PIXELS = WIDTH * HEIGHT;
  var MAX_BYTES = 12 * 1024 * 1024, MAX_EDGE = 8192, MAX_PIXELS = 40000000;

  function fail(message) { throw new Error(message); }
  function size(width, height) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(width) || !Number.isInteger(height) || width < 1 || height < 1 ||
      width > MAX_EDGE || height > MAX_EDGE || width * height > MAX_PIXELS) {
      fail('图片尺寸超限：最长边不得超过 8192 像素，总像素不得超过 4000 万。');
    }
    return { width: width, height: height };
  }
  function ascii(bytes, offset, count) {
    var value = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) value += String.fromCharCode(bytes[offset + i]);
    return value;
  }
  function u16(bytes, offset) { return bytes[offset] * 256 + bytes[offset + 1]; }
  function u24le(bytes, offset) { return bytes[offset] + bytes[offset + 1] * 256 + bytes[offset + 2] * 65536; }

  // Header bounds are checked before any decoder or image object is created.
  // All input is local and bounded; only the fixed-size result leaves this API.
  function dimensions(bytes) {
    var view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength), result = null;
    if (bytes.length >= 33 && ascii(bytes, 0, 8) === '\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n') {
      if (view.getUint32(8) !== 13 || ascii(bytes, 12, 4) !== 'IHDR') fail('PNG 文件头无效。');
      result = size(view.getUint32(16), view.getUint32(20));
      var pngOffset = 8, ended = false, pixels = false;
      while (pngOffset + 12 <= bytes.length) {
        var pngLength = view.getUint32(pngOffset), pngType = ascii(bytes, pngOffset + 4, 4);
        if (pngLength > bytes.length - pngOffset - 12) fail('PNG 文件不完整。');
        if (pngType === 'IHDR' && pngOffset !== 8) fail('PNG 含多组尺寸信息，请重新导出图片。');
        if (pngType === 'acTL') fail('请选择静态图片，不支持动画 PNG。');
        if (pngType === 'IDAT') pixels = true;
        pngOffset += pngLength + 12;
        if (pngType === 'IEND') { ended = pngLength === 0; break; }
      }
      if (!ended || !pixels || pngOffset !== bytes.length) fail('PNG 文件不完整。');
      result.type = 'image/png'; return result;
    }
    if (bytes.length >= 4 && bytes[0] === 255 && bytes[1] === 216) {
      var jpegOffset = 2;
      while (jpegOffset + 1 < bytes.length) {
        if (bytes[jpegOffset++] !== 255) fail('JPEG 文件头无效。');
        while (jpegOffset < bytes.length && bytes[jpegOffset] === 255) jpegOffset++;
        var marker = bytes[jpegOffset++];
        if (marker === 217) break;
        if (marker === 218) {
          if (!result || jpegOffset + 2 > bytes.length || u16(bytes, jpegOffset) < 2 || u16(bytes, jpegOffset) > bytes.length - jpegOffset) break;
          result.type = 'image/jpeg'; return result;
        }
        if (marker === 1 || marker >= 208 && marker <= 215) continue;
        if (jpegOffset + 2 > bytes.length) break;
        var jpegLength = u16(bytes, jpegOffset);
        if (jpegLength < 2 || jpegLength > bytes.length - jpegOffset) fail('JPEG 文件不完整。');
        if ([192, 193, 194, 195, 197, 198, 199, 201, 202, 203, 205, 206, 207].indexOf(marker) >= 0) {
          if (jpegLength < 8) fail('JPEG 尺寸信息无效。');
          if (result) fail('JPEG 含多组尺寸信息，请重新导出图片。');
          result = size(u16(bytes, jpegOffset + 5), u16(bytes, jpegOffset + 3));
        }
        jpegOffset += jpegLength;
      }
      fail('无法读取 JPEG 图片尺寸。');
    }
    if (bytes.length >= 20 && ascii(bytes, 0, 4) === 'RIFF' && ascii(bytes, 8, 4) === 'WEBP') {
      if (view.getUint32(4, true) + 8 !== bytes.length) fail('WebP 文件不完整。');
      var webpOffset = 12, frame = null;
      while (webpOffset + 8 <= bytes.length) {
        var webpType = ascii(bytes, webpOffset, 4), webpLength = view.getUint32(webpOffset + 4, true);
        var start = webpOffset + 8;
        if (webpLength > bytes.length - start) fail('WebP 文件不完整。');
        if (webpType === 'ANIM' || webpType === 'ANMF') fail('请选择静态图片，不支持动画 WebP。');
        if (webpType === 'VP8X') {
          if (webpLength !== 10) fail('WebP 扩展文件头无效。');
          if (bytes[start] & 2) fail('请选择静态图片，不支持动画 WebP。');
          result = size(u24le(bytes, start + 4) + 1, u24le(bytes, start + 7) + 1);
        } else if (webpType === 'VP8 ') {
          if (webpLength < 10 || bytes[start] & 1 || ascii(bytes, start + 3, 3) !== '\x9d\x01\x2a') fail('WebP 图片数据无效。');
          frame = size(view.getUint16(start + 6, true) & 16383, view.getUint16(start + 8, true) & 16383);
        } else if (webpType === 'VP8L') {
          if (webpLength < 5 || bytes[start] !== 47) fail('WebP 无损文件头无效。');
          var bits = view.getUint32(start + 1, true);
          if (bits >>> 29) fail('WebP 无损版本无效。');
          frame = size((bits & 16383) + 1, (bits >>> 14 & 16383) + 1);
        }
        webpOffset = start + webpLength + (webpLength & 1);
      }
      if (webpOffset !== bytes.length || !frame) fail('无法读取 WebP 图片尺寸。');
      result = result || frame; result.type = 'image/webp'; return result;
    }
    fail('仅支持有效的 JPEG、PNG 或静态 WebP 图片。');
  }

  function encodeRGBA(rgba, width, height) {
    var kind = Object.prototype.toString.call(rgba);
    if (width !== WIDTH || height !== HEIGHT || !rgba || rgba.length !== PIXELS * 4 ||
      (kind !== '[object Uint8Array]' && kind !== '[object Uint8ClampedArray]')) fail('壁纸像素必须为 320 × 480 的 RGBA 字节数组。');
    var bytes = new Uint8Array(16 + PIXELS * 2), view = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
    for (var h = 0; h < 8; h++) bytes[h] = 'TFWP5651'.charCodeAt(h);
    view.setUint16(8, WIDTH, true); view.setUint16(10, HEIGHT, true); view.setUint32(12, PIXELS * 2, true);
    for (var i = 0; i < PIXELS; i++) {
      var source = i * 4, alpha = rgba[source + 3] / 255;
      var r = Math.round(rgba[source] * alpha), g = Math.round(rgba[source + 1] * alpha), b = Math.round(rgba[source + 2] * alpha);
      view.setUint16(16 + i * 2, (r >> 3) << 11 | (g >> 2) << 5 | b >> 3, true);
    }
    return bytes;
  }

  // UFI can be served over a local HTTP address, where SubtleCrypto is absent.
  // Hash only the prepared local package; this does not access browser storage.
  function sha256(bytes) {
    if (!ArrayBuffer.isView(bytes) || bytes.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT !== 1) fail('校验数据必须为字节数组。');
    var constants = [
      0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
      0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
      0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
      0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
      0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
      0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
      0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
      0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
    ];
    var hash = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];
    var length = bytes.byteLength, padded = new Uint8Array(Math.ceil((length + 9) / 64) * 64);
    padded.set(new Uint8Array(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, length)); padded[length] = 128;
    var view = new DataView(padded.buffer), words = new Uint32Array(64);
    view.setUint32(padded.length - 8, Math.floor(length / 0x20000000));
    view.setUint32(padded.length - 4, length * 8 >>> 0);
    function rotate(value, count) { return value >>> count | value << (32 - count); }
    for (var offset = 0; offset < padded.length; offset += 64) {
      for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++) words[i] = view.getUint32(offset + i * 4);
      for (i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
        var x = words[i - 15], y = words[i - 2];
        words[i] = words[i - 16] + (rotate(x, 7) ^ rotate(x, 18) ^ x >>> 3) + words[i - 7] + (rotate(y, 17) ^ rotate(y, 19) ^ y >>> 10);
      }
      var a = hash[0], b = hash[1], c = hash[2], d = hash[3], e = hash[4], f = hash[5], g = hash[6], h = hash[7];
      for (i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        var first = h + (rotate(e, 6) ^ rotate(e, 11) ^ rotate(e, 25)) + ((e & f) ^ (~e & g)) + constants[i] + words[i];
        var second = (rotate(a, 2) ^ rotate(a, 13) ^ rotate(a, 22)) + ((a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c));
        h = g; g = f; f = e; e = d + first >>> 0; d = c; c = b; b = a; a = first + second >>> 0;
      }
      var state = [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h];
      for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) hash[i] = hash[i] + state[i] >>> 0;
    }
    return hash.map(function (word) { return ('00000000' + word.toString(16)).slice(-8); }).join('');
  }

  function readFile(root, file) {
    if (typeof file.arrayBuffer === 'function') return file.arrayBuffer();
    if (!root || typeof root.FileReader !== 'function') fail('当前浏览器不支持读取本地图片。');
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var reader = new root.FileReader();
      reader.onload = function () { resolve(reader.result); };
      reader.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('本地图片读取失败。')); };
      reader.onabort = function () { reject(new Error('本地图片读取已取消。')); };
      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
    });
  }

  async function prepare(root, file) {
    if (!file || !Number.isInteger(file.size) || file.size < 1 || file.size > MAX_BYTES) fail('图片文件不得为空，且不能超过 12 MiB。');
    var input = await readFile(root, file);
    if (!input || input.byteLength !== file.size) fail('本地图片读取不完整。');
    var source = dimensions(new Uint8Array(input));
    input = null;
    if (file.type && String(file.type).toLowerCase() !== source.type) fail('图片格式与文件类型不一致，请重新导出 JPEG、PNG 或 WebP。');
    if (!root || !root.document || !root.URL || typeof root.URL.createObjectURL !== 'function') fail('当前浏览器不支持本地壁纸预览。');
    var decoded = null, canvas = null, inputUrl = '', previewUrl = '', image = null;
    function releaseImage() {
      if (decoded && typeof decoded.close === 'function') decoded.close();
      decoded = null;
      if (image) { image.onload = image.onerror = null; image.src = ''; image = null; }
      if (inputUrl) { root.URL.revokeObjectURL(inputUrl); inputUrl = ''; }
    }
    try {
      if (typeof root.createImageBitmap === 'function') decoded = await root.createImageBitmap(file, { imageOrientation: 'from-image' });
      else {
        if (typeof root.Image !== 'function') fail('当前浏览器不支持图片解码。');
        inputUrl = root.URL.createObjectURL(file);
        image = new root.Image();
        decoded = await new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
          image.onload = function () { resolve(image); };
          image.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('图片无法解码，请重新导出后选择。')); };
          image.src = inputUrl;
        });
      }
      var actual = size(decoded.naturalWidth || decoded.width, decoded.naturalHeight || decoded.height);
      // EXIF orientation may swap width and height. Both decoded bounds and
      // input-header bounds are checked, without allocating an original-size canvas.
      canvas = root.document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = WIDTH; canvas.height = HEIGHT;
      var context = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false, willReadFrequently: true });
      if (!context) fail('当前浏览器无法创建壁纸画布。');
      context.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; context.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
      context.fillStyle = '#000'; context.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
      var scale = Math.max(WIDTH / actual.width, HEIGHT / actual.height);
      var cropWidth = WIDTH / scale, cropHeight = HEIGHT / scale;
      context.drawImage(decoded, (actual.width - cropWidth) / 2, (actual.height - cropHeight) / 2,
        cropWidth, cropHeight, 0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
      releaseImage();
      var bytes = encodeRGBA(context.getImageData(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT).data, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
      var blob = await new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        if (typeof canvas.toBlob !== 'function') { reject(new Error('当前浏览器不支持生成本地预览。')); return; }
        canvas.toBlob(function (value) { if (value) resolve(value); else reject(new Error('壁纸预览生成失败。')); }, 'image/png');
      });
      previewUrl = root.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      var ownedUrl = previewUrl, disposed = false;
      return {
        bytes: bytes, previewUrl: ownedUrl, width: WIDTH, height: HEIGHT,
        sourceWidth: actual.width, sourceHeight: actual.height,
        dispose: function () { if (!disposed) { disposed = true; root.URL.revokeObjectURL(ownedUrl); } }
      };
    } catch (error) {
      if (previewUrl) root.URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      releaseImage();
      if (canvas) { canvas.width = 1; canvas.height = 1; }
    }
  }

  return { prepare: prepare, encodeRGBA: encodeRGBA, sha256: sha256 };
});

(function (root, factory) {
  if (typeof module === 'object' && module.exports) module.exports = factory();

})(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : this, function () {
  'use strict';
  var BYTES = 307216, CHUNK = 24576, BOOT = /^[a-f0-9]{8}-(?:[a-f0-9]{4}-){3}[a-f0-9]{12}$/;
  var ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';
  function line(text, prefix) {
    var found = String(text).split(/\r?\n/).filter(function (value) { return value.indexOf(prefix) === 0; });
    if (found.length !== 1) throw Error('壁纸备份响应未确认；旧组件保留');
    return found[0].slice(prefix.length);
  }
  function snapshot(text) {
    var value = JSON.parse(line(text, 'TOPFLOW_WALLPAPER_BACKUP='));
    if (!value || !BOOT.test(value.bootId || '') || !(value.sha256 === null || /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value.sha256))) throw Error('壁纸备份状态无效；旧组件保留');
    return { sha256: value.sha256, bootId: value.bootId };
  }
  function decode(text, length) {
    if (text.length !== Math.ceil(length / 3) * 4 || !/^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/.test(text)) throw Error('壁纸备份分块不完整；旧组件保留');
    var result = new Uint8Array(length), at = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < text.length; i += 4) {
      var a = ALPHABET.indexOf(text[i]), b = ALPHABET.indexOf(text[i + 1]), c = ALPHABET.indexOf(text[i + 2]), d = ALPHABET.indexOf(text[i + 3]);
      result[at++] = a << 2 | b >> 4;
      if (at < length) result[at++] = b << 4 | c >> 2;
      if (at < length) result[at++] = c << 6 | d;
    }
    return result;
  }
  function base64(bytes) {
    var text = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
      var a = bytes[i], b = bytes[i + 1] || 0, c = bytes[i + 2] || 0;
      text += ALPHABET[a >> 2] + ALPHABET[(a & 3) << 4 | b >> 4] + (i + 1 < bytes.length ? ALPHABET[(b & 15) << 2 | c >> 6] : '=') + (i + 2 < bytes.length ? ALPHABET[c & 63] : '=');
    }
    return text;
  }
  function validate(value, hash) {
    if (!value || !value.bytes || value.bytes.length !== BYTES || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value.sha256 || '') || hash(value.bytes) !== value.sha256) throw Error('内存壁纸校验失败，未写入设备');
    var header = [84,70,87,80,53,54,53,49,64,1,224,1,0,176,4,0];
    for (var i = 0; i < header.length; i++) if (value.bytes[i] !== header[i]) throw Error('壁纸格式无效，未写入设备');
  }
  async function backup(context) {
    var first = snapshot(await context.read(null)), saved = { sha256: first.sha256, bootId: first.bootId, bytes: null, transaction: null };
    if (first.sha256 !== null) {
      saved.bytes = new Uint8Array(BYTES);
      for (var offset = 0; offset < BYTES; offset += CHUNK) {
        var count = Math.min(CHUNK, BYTES - offset);
        saved.bytes.set(decode(line(await context.read(first, offset), 'TOPFLOW_WALLPAPER_CHUNK='), count), offset);
      }
      validate(saved, context.hash);
    }
    var last = snapshot(await context.read(first));
    if (last.sha256 !== first.sha256 || last.bootId !== first.bootId) throw Error('备份期间壁纸或设备已变化；旧组件保留');
    return saved;
  }
  async function restore(saved, context) {
    validate(saved, context.hash);
    var state = context.parse(await context.command('status'));
    if (state.configured && !state.pending && state.sha256 === saved.sha256) return true;
    if (state.configured && state.sha256 !== saved.sha256) throw Error('设备已有其他壁纸；未覆盖，请先核对');
    if (state.pending) {
      if (!saved.transaction || state.pendingNonce !== saved.transaction.nonce || state.pendingSha256 !== saved.sha256) throw Error('存在其他未完成的壁纸上传；保留内存备份');
      if (!state.previousBoot && state.uploadValid) {
        await context.command('commit', saved.sha256, 'COMMITTED', saved.transaction);
      } else {
        // Only an explicit user retry reaches an existing transaction. Never
        // automatically retry a timed-out chunk or a commit with unknown result.
        await context.command('abort', saved.sha256, 'ABORTED', { nonce: state.pendingNonce, bootId: state.bootId });
        saved.transaction = null;
      }
      state = context.parse(await context.command('status'));
      if (state.pending) throw Error('上次壁纸上传清理未确认；保留内存备份');
    }
    if (!state.configured) {
      var nonce = context.nonce();
      if (!/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(nonce)) throw Error('壁纸事务随机数无效');
      saved.transaction = { nonce: nonce, bootId: state.bootId };
      await context.command('prepare', saved.sha256, 'PREPARED', saved.transaction);
      for (var offset = 0; offset < BYTES; offset += CHUNK) {
        await context.command('chunk', saved.sha256, 'CHUNKED', { nonce: nonce, bootId: state.bootId, offset: offset, base64: base64(saved.bytes.subarray(offset, Math.min(offset + CHUNK, BYTES))) });
      }
      await context.command('commit', saved.sha256, 'COMMITTED', saved.transaction);
    }
    state = context.parse(await context.command('status'));
    if (!state.configured || state.pending || state.sha256 !== saved.sha256) throw Error('壁纸恢复回读未确认；保留内存备份');
    return true;
  }
  return { backup: backup, restore: restore, snapshot: snapshot };
});

  function failureStatusMessage(state) {
    var message = failureMessage(state.failure);
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rendererFailures, state.rendererFailure)) message += '；失败阶段：' + rendererFailures[state.rendererFailure] + '（' + state.rendererFailure + '）';
    if (Number.isInteger(state.rendererExitStatus) && state.rendererExitStatus >= 0 && state.rendererExitStatus <= 255) {
      message += '；Shell 退出状态：' + state.rendererExitStatus;
      if (state.rendererExitStatus >= 128) message += '（可能与信号有关，单凭此值不能确定原因）';
    }
    return message;
  }
  function waitingMessage(state) {
    return (state.waiting === 'FACTORY_INTERNAL_LOCK_UNSTABLE' ? '原厂状态正在更新。' : '') +
      '等待原厂自然熄屏并释放休眠锁；熄屏后通常还需约3分钟。等待期间原厂继续运行，请暂不触碰屏幕，可取消。' +
      (Number.isSafeInteger(state.waitingRemaining) ? '本次最多还等待 ' + state.waitingRemaining + ' 秒。' : '本次最多等待6分钟。') + '这是等待上限，不是预计完成时间；条件满足会提前切换。';
  }
  function shellFailure(response, result) {
    var content = result && typeof result.content === 'string' ? result.content : '';
    var marker = content.match(/(?:^|\r?\n)TOPFLOW_ERROR=([A-Z_]+)(?:\r?\n|$)/);
    if (marker) return error(marker[1], failureMessage(marker[1]));
    var status = response && Number.isInteger(response.status) ? response.status : 0;
    if (status === 401 || status === 403) return error('UFI_AUTH_REQUIRED', 'UFI 登录或 Shell 权限未通过（HTTP ' + status + '），请在原面板重新登录后刷新');
    if (status && response.ok === false) return error('UFI_HTTP_' + status, 'UFI Shell 接口返回 HTTP ' + status + '，未确认执行结果');
    var reason = /permission denied/i.test(content) ? '权限不足' : /read-only file system/i.test(content) ? '目标文件系统只读' : /syntax error/i.test(content) ? 'Shell 语法不兼容' : /not found/i.test(content) ? '所需命令或文件不存在' : /timed?\s*out|timeout/i.test(content) ? '执行超时' : '返回值或执行结果未确认';
    return error('SHELL_FAILED', 'UFI Shell 调用失败：' + reason);
  }
  function shellQuote(value) { return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "'\"'\"'") + "'"; }
  function token(value) { if (!/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(value || '')) throw error('INVALID_TOKEN', '安装会话无效'); return value; }
  function hash(value) { if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value)) throw error('INVALID_HASH', '安装包校验值无效'); return value; }
  function releaseAllowed(payload) { if (payload && payload.reviewOnly === true) throw error('RELEASE_BLOCKED', '当前文件仅供本地审查，实体屏安装/启动已阻止；请使用明确标注待设备验收的开发测试 TXT'); }
  function nativePayload(payload) {
    if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && verifiedPayloads.has(payload)) return payload;
    if (!payload || payload.hardwareTested !== false || typeof payload.archiveBase64 !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(payload.archiveBase64) || payload.archiveBase64.length > 3 * 1024 * 1024) throw error('INVALID_PACKAGE', '原生包无效或超出大小限制');
    hash(payload.archiveSha256); hash(payload.screenctlSha256);
    if (typeof payload.screenctlSource !== 'string' || !payload.screenctlSource.startsWith('#!/bin/sh\n') || payload.screenctlSource.length > 98304 || payload.screenctlSource.includes('\0')) throw error('INVALID_PACKAGE', '内置恢复控制器无效');
    if (!Array.isArray(payload.members) || !payload.members.length || payload.members.some(function (name) { return typeof name !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+\/?$/.test(name) || name.startsWith('/') || name.split('/').some(function (part) { return part === '..'; }); })) throw error('INVALID_PACKAGE', '原生包路径无效');
    return payload;
  }
  function privatePayload(input) {
    // Capture getters once, validate the captured data, then freeze only our
    // private copy. External frozen objects are never implicitly trusted.
    var copy = Object.assign({}, input);
    if (Array.isArray(copy.members)) copy.members = copy.members.slice();
    nativePayload(copy);
    Object.freeze(copy.members); Object.freeze(copy);
    verifiedPayloads.add(copy);
    return copy;
  }
  function rootGuard() {
    return 'TF_ROOT=/data/plugins/topflow-screen\n[ "$(readlink -f /data/plugins 2>/dev/null)" = /data/plugins ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNSAFE_PARENT; exit 1; }\n';
  }
  function ownerGuard(owner) {
    token(owner);
    return rootGuard() + '[ -d "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$TF_ROOT")" = "$TF_ROOT" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNSAFE_TARGET; exit 1; }\n' +
      '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner" ] && [ "$(cat "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner")" = ' + shellQuote(owner) + ' ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=INSTALL_OWNER; exit 1; }\n';
  }
  function installedMembers(payload) {
    return payload.members.map(function (name) { return name.replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, ''); }).filter(Boolean);
  }
  function ownershipGuard(payload) { nativePayload(payload); return ownershipClause(payload); }
  function ownershipClause(payload) {
    return '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-install" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-install" ] && [ "$(cat "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-install")" = "$(printf \'TOPFLOW_SCREEN_INSTALL_V1\\n%s\' ' + shellQuote(payload.archiveSha256) + ')" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNVERIFIED_OWNERSHIP; exit 1; }\n' +
      '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-files" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-files" ] && [ "$(cat "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-files")" = "$(printf \'%s\\n\' ' + installedMembers(payload).map(shellQuote).join(' ') + ')" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNVERIFIED_MANIFEST; exit 1; }\n';
  }
  function screenOwnershipGuard(payload, wallpaperSnapshot, restoreSha, currentOnly) {
    nativePayload(payload);
    // Several exact releases share the same member list. Reuse only identical
    // bytes; every archive digest and every per-file check remains independent.
    var memberLists = [];
    function verifyOwned(archive) {
      var members = installedMembers(archive).join('\n'), index = memberLists.indexOf(members);
      if (index < 0) { index = memberLists.length; memberLists.push(members); }
      return 'tf_verify_owned ' + shellQuote(archive.archiveSha256) + ' "$TF_MEMBERS_' + index + '"\n';
    }
    var currentOwnership = verifyOwned(payload);
    var helpers = 'tf_verify_owned() {\n' +
      '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-install" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-install" ] && [ "$(cat "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-install")" = "$(printf \'TOPFLOW_SCREEN_INSTALL_V1\\n%s\' "$1")" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNVERIFIED_OWNERSHIP; exit 1; }\n' +
      '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-files" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-files" ] && [ "$(cat "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-files")" = "$2" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNVERIFIED_MANIFEST; exit 1; }\n}\n' +
      'tf_verify_legacy_cleaning() {\nTF_LEGACY_CLEANING=false\nif [ -e "$TF_ROOT/.uninstalling" ] || [ -L "$TF_ROOT/.uninstalling" ]; then\n' +
      '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/.uninstalling" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.uninstalling" ] && [ "$(stat -c %h "$TF_ROOT/.uninstalling")" = 1 ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$TF_ROOT/.uninstalling")" = 0 ] && [ "$(cat "$TF_ROOT/.uninstalling")" = uninstalling ] && [ ! -e "$TF_ROOT/.upload-active" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.upload-active" ] && [ ! -e "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNVERIFIED_LEGACY_FILES; exit 1; }\nTF_LEGACY_CLEANING=true\nfi\n}\n' +
      // This internal name is repeated for every trusted archive member.
      // Keep it short without removing any ownership or checksum checks.
      'tf_lf() {\n' +
      'if [ ! -e "$TF_ROOT/$1" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/$1" ] && [ "$TF_LEGACY_CLEANING" = true ]; then return 0; fi\n' +
      '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/$1" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/$1" ] && [ "$(stat -c %h "$TF_ROOT/$1")" = 1 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNVERIFIED_LEGACY_FILES; exit 1; }\n' +
      'printf \'%s  %s\\n\' "$2" "$TF_ROOT/$1" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNVERIFIED_LEGACY_FILES; exit 1; }\n}\n';
    var branches = (currentOnly ? [] : recoveryArchives).map(function (archive) {
      var checks = Object.keys(archive.files).map(function (name) { return 'tf_lf ' + shellQuote(name) + ' ' + shellQuote(archive.files[name]) + '\n'; }).join('');
      return 'elif [ "$TF_INSTALLED_MARKER" = "$(printf \'TOPFLOW_SCREEN_INSTALL_V1\\n%s\' ' + shellQuote(archive.archiveSha256) + ')" ]; then\n' + verifyOwned(archive) + 'tf_verify_legacy_cleaning\n' + checks + 'TF_VERSION_MISMATCH=true\n';
    }).join('');
    var memberConstants = memberLists.map(function (members, index) { return 'TF_MEMBERS_' + index + '=' + shellQuote(members) + '\n'; }).join('');
    return memberConstants + helpers + 'tf_verify_install() {\nTF_VERSION_MISMATCH=false\n' +
      'TF_INSTALLED_MARKER=$(cat "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-install" 2>/dev/null || true)\n' +
      'if [ "$TF_INSTALLED_MARKER" = "$(printf \'TOPFLOW_SCREEN_INSTALL_V1\\n%s\' ' + shellQuote(payload.archiveSha256) + ')" ]; then\n' + currentOwnership + branches +
      'else echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=INSTALLED_VERSION_MISMATCH; exit 1; fi\n' + (wallpaperSnapshot ? wallpaperSnapshotChecks(wallpaperSnapshot) : '') + (restoreSha ? wallpaperRestoreChecks(restoreSha) : '') + '}\ntf_verify_install\n';
  }
  function memoryController(action, payload) {
    return '(\nset -- ' + action + (action === 'status' ? '' : ' --confirmed') + '\n' + payload.screenctlSource.replace(/\n?$/, '\n') + ')\n';
  }
  function installLock(owner, payload) {
    return ownerGuard(owner) + ownershipGuard(payload) +
      'TF_ROOT_ID=$(stat -c %d:%i "$TF_ROOT")\n[ -f "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock" ] && [ "$(stat -c %h "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock")" = 1 ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock")" = 0 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNSAFE_LOCK; exit 1; }\n' +
      'exec 7<"$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock"\nTF_LOCK_ID=$(stat -L -c %d:%i "/proc/self/fd/7")\nflock -n 7 || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=CONTROL_BUSY; exit 1; }\n' +
      '[ "$(stat -c %d:%i "$TF_ROOT")" = "$TF_ROOT_ID" ] && [ "$(stat -c %d:%i "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock")" = "$TF_LOCK_ID" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=INSTALL_CHANGED; exit 1; }\n' +
      'TF_RUN=/tmp/topflow-screen\n[ -d "$TF_RUN" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_RUN" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$TF_RUN")" = "$TF_RUN" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$TF_RUN")" = 0 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNSAFE_RUNTIME; exit 1; }\n' +
      '[ ! -L "$TF_RUN/control.lock" ] && { [ ! -e "$TF_RUN/control.lock" ] || { [ -f "$TF_RUN/control.lock" ] && [ "$(stat -c %h "$TF_RUN/control.lock")" = 1 ]; }; } || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNSAFE_LOCK; exit 1; }\n' +
      'exec 9>"$TF_RUN/control.lock"\nflock -n 9 || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=CONTROL_BUSY; exit 1; }\n' + ownerGuard(owner) + ownershipGuard(payload);
  }
  function buildInstallStart(owner, payload) {
    releaseAllowed(payload);
    token(owner);
    nativePayload(payload);
    return 'set -eu\numask 077\n' + rootGuard() +
      'for TF_TOOL in sha256sum tar flock; do command -v "$TF_TOOL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=MISSING_TOOL; exit 1; }; done\n' +
      '[ "$(uname -m)" = aarch64 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNSUPPORTED_ARCH; exit 1; }\n' +
      '[ ! -e "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=TARGET_EXISTS; exit 1; }\n' +
      'mkdir "$TF_ROOT"\n: > "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock"\nprintf \'%s\' ' + shellQuote(owner) + ' > "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner"\n' +
      'printf \'%s\\n\' ' + installedMembers(payload).map(shellQuote).join(' ') + ' > "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-files"\n' +
      'TF_RUN=/tmp/topflow-screen\n[ ! -e "$TF_RUN" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_RUN" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=RUNTIME_EXISTS; exit 1; }\nmkdir "$TF_RUN"\n' +
      'printf \'%s\' ' + shellQuote(owner) + ' > "$TF_ROOT/.upload-active"\n' +
      'printf \'TOPFLOW_SCREEN_INSTALL_V1\\n%s\\n\' ' + shellQuote(payload.archiveSha256) + ' > "$TF_ROOT/.topflow-install"\n' +
      'printf \'TOPFLOW_INSTALL=READY\\n\'\n';
  }
  function buildUploadComplete(owner, payload) {
    nativePayload(payload);
    return 'set -eu\numask 077\n' + installLock(owner, payload) +
      '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/.upload-active" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.upload-active" ] && [ "$(cat "$TF_ROOT/.upload-active")" = ' + shellQuote(token(owner)) + ' ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UPLOAD_OWNER; exit 1; }\n' +
      'rm -f "$TF_ROOT/.upload-active"\nprintf \'TOPFLOW_INSTALL=UPLOAD_FINISHED\\n\'\n';
  }
  function buildInstallFinish(owner, payload) {
    releaseAllowed(payload);
    nativePayload(payload);
    var allowed = payload.members.map(shellQuote).join('|');
    return 'set -eu\numask 077\n' + installLock(owner, payload) +
      '[ ! -e "$TF_ROOT/.upload-active" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.upload-active" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UPLOAD_ACTIVE; exit 1; }\n' +
      '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/.payload.tar.gz" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.payload.tar.gz" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=INVALID_ARCHIVE; exit 1; }\n' +
      'printf \'%s  %s\\n\' ' + shellQuote(payload.archiveSha256) + ' "$TF_ROOT/.payload.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -\n' +
      'TF_MEMBERS=$(tar -tzf "$TF_ROOT/.payload.tar.gz")\nprintf \'%s\\n\' "$TF_MEMBERS" | while IFS= read -r TF_MEMBER; do case "$TF_MEMBER" in ' + allowed + ') ;; *) echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNEXPECTED_MEMBER; exit 1;; esac; done\n' +
      'tar -xzf "$TF_ROOT/.payload.tar.gz" -C "$TF_ROOT"\n' +
      '(cd "$TF_ROOT" && sha256sum -c topflow-screen.sha256)\n' +
      'chmod 700 "$TF_ROOT"\nchmod 755 "$TF_ROOT/topflow-screen" "$TF_ROOT/topflow-factory-bus-aarch64" "$TF_ROOT/screenctl.sh" "$TF_ROOT/supervisor.sh"\n' +
      'rm -f "$TF_ROOT/.payload.tar.gz" "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner"\nprintf \'TOPFLOW_INSTALL=INSTALLED_NOT_STARTED\\n\'\n';
  }
  function buildScreenCommand(action, payload, confirmed, wallpaperSnapshot) {
    if (!['status', 'start', 'restore', 'uninstall', 'autostart-enable', 'autostart-disable'].includes(action)) throw error('INVALID_ACTION', '屏幕动作无效');
    if (action !== 'status' && confirmed !== true) throw error('CONFIRM_REQUIRED', '须明确确认本次屏幕切换');
    if (action === 'start' || action === 'autostart-enable') releaseAllowed(payload);
    nativePayload(payload);
    if (wallpaperSnapshot && action !== 'uninstall') throw error('INVALID_ACTION', '壁纸迁移校验仅用于更新清理');
    var command = 'set -eu\n' + rootGuard();
    if (action === 'status') command += 'if [ ! -e "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT" ]; then if pidof zte_topsw_devui >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf \'TOPFLOW_SCREEN={"installed":false,"mode":"factory"}\\n\'; else printf \'TOPFLOW_SCREEN={"installed":false,"mode":"unknown"}\\n\'; fi; exit 0; fi\n';
    command += '[ -d "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$TF_ROOT")" = "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$TF_ROOT")" = 0 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNSAFE_TARGET; exit 1; }\n' + screenOwnershipGuard(payload, wallpaperSnapshot);
    if (action === 'start' || action === 'autostart-enable' || action === 'autostart-disable') {
      command += '[ "$TF_VERSION_MISMATCH" = false ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=INSTALLED_VERSION_MISMATCH; exit 1; }\n' +
        '[ ! -e "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner" ] && [ -f "$TF_ROOT/screenctl.sh" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/screenctl.sh" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=INSTALL_INCOMPLETE; exit 1; }\n' +
        'printf \'%s  %s\\n\' ' + shellQuote(payload.screenctlSha256) + ' "$TF_ROOT/screenctl.sh" | sha256sum -c -\n' +
        'sh "$TF_ROOT/screenctl.sh" ' + action + ' --confirmed\n' + (action === 'start' ? 'printf \'TOPFLOW_SWITCH=SUBMITTED\\n\'\n' : '');
    } else if (action === 'status') {
      command += 'TF_PARTIAL=false\nif [ -e "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner" ] || [ ! -f "$TF_ROOT/screenctl.sh" ]; then TF_PARTIAL=true; fi\nTF_UPLOAD=false\nif [ -e "$TF_ROOT/.upload-active" ]; then TF_UPLOAD=true; fi\n' +
        'TF_STATE=$(\n' + memoryController('status', payload) + ')\nprintf \'TOPFLOW_SCREEN={"partial":%s,"uploadActive":%s,"versionMismatch":%s,%s\\n\' "$TF_PARTIAL" "$TF_UPLOAD" "$TF_VERSION_MISMATCH" "${TF_STATE#\\{}"\n';
    } else {
      command += memoryController(action, payload);
      if (action === 'restore') command += 'printf \'TOPFLOW_SWITCH=SUBMITTED\\n\'\n';
    }
    return command;
  }
  function wallpaperSnapshotChecks(snapshot) {
    if (!snapshot || !/^[a-f0-9]{8}-(?:[a-f0-9]{4}-){3}[a-f0-9]{12}$/.test(snapshot.bootId || '') || !(snapshot.sha256 === null || /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(snapshot.sha256 || ''))) throw error('INVALID_WALLPAPER_BACKUP', '壁纸备份信息无效');
    var file = '"$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565"';
    return '[ "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = ' + shellQuote(snapshot.bootId) + ' ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=WALLPAPER_BACKUP_CHANGED; exit 1; }\n' +
      'for TF_TEMP in .lock-wallpaper.pending .lock-wallpaper.upload .lock-wallpaper.chunk; do [ ! -e "$TF_ROOT/$TF_TEMP" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/$TF_TEMP" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=WALLPAPER_UPLOAD_PENDING; exit 1; }; done\n' +
      (snapshot.sha256 === null ? '[ ! -e ' + file + ' ] && [ ! -L ' + file + ' ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=WALLPAPER_BACKUP_CHANGED; exit 1; }\n' :
        '[ -f ' + file + ' ] && [ ! -L ' + file + ' ] && [ "$(stat -c %u ' + file + ')" = 0 ] && [ "$(stat -c %h ' + file + ')" = 1 ] && [ "$(wc -c < ' + file + ')" = 307216 ] && [ "$(od -An -v -tx1 -N16 ' + file + ' | tr -d \' \\n\')" = 54465750353635314001e00100b00400 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=WALLPAPER_BACKUP_CHANGED; exit 1; }\n' +
        'printf \'%s  %s\\n\' ' + shellQuote(snapshot.sha256) + ' ' + file + ' | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=WALLPAPER_BACKUP_CHANGED; exit 1; }\n');
  }
  function buildWallpaperBackupCommand(payload, snapshot, offset) {
    nativePayload(payload);
    if (offset !== undefined && (!snapshot || snapshot.sha256 === null || !Number.isSafeInteger(offset) || offset < 0 || offset >= 307216 || offset % 24576 !== 0)) throw error('INVALID_CHUNK', '壁纸备份分块无效');
    var command = 'set -eu\n' + rootGuard() +
      '[ -d "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$TF_ROOT")" = "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$TF_ROOT")" = 0 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNSAFE_TARGET; exit 1; }\n' + screenOwnershipGuard(payload) +
      'TF_ROOT_ID=$(stat -c %d:%i "$TF_ROOT")\n[ -f "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock" ] && [ "$(stat -c %h "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock")" = 1 ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock")" = 0 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNSAFE_LOCK; exit 1; }\n' +
      'exec 7<"$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock"\nTF_LOCK_ID=$(stat -L -c %d:%i /proc/self/fd/7)\nflock -n 7 || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=CONTROL_BUSY; exit 1; }\n' +
      '[ "$(stat -c %d:%i "$TF_ROOT")" = "$TF_ROOT_ID" ] && [ "$(stat -c %d:%i "$TF_ROOT/.lifecycle.lock")" = "$TF_LOCK_ID" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=INSTALL_CHANGED; exit 1; }\ntf_verify_install\n' +
      'for TF_TEMP in .install-owner .upload-active .uninstalling .lock-wallpaper.pending .lock-wallpaper.upload .lock-wallpaper.chunk; do [ ! -e "$TF_ROOT/$TF_TEMP" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/$TF_TEMP" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=WALLPAPER_UPLOAD_PENDING; exit 1; }; done\n' +
      'TF_BOOT=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)\nprintf \'%s\\n\' "$TF_BOOT" | grep -Eq \'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$\' || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=WALLPAPER_BOOT_ID_UNAVAILABLE; exit 1; }\n';
    if (snapshot) command += wallpaperSnapshotChecks(snapshot);
    if (offset !== undefined) return command + 'printf \'TOPFLOW_WALLPAPER_CHUNK=\'\ndd if="$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" bs=24576 skip=' + offset / 24576 + ' count=1 2>/dev/null | base64 | tr -d \'\\r\\n\'\nprintf \'\\n\'\n' + wallpaperSnapshotChecks(snapshot);
    return command + 'if [ ! -e "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" ]; then TF_HASH=null; else\n' +
      '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565")" = 0 ] && [ "$(stat -c %h "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565")" = 1 ] && [ "$(wc -c < "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565")" = 307216 ] && [ "$(od -An -v -tx1 -N16 "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" | tr -d \' \\n\')" = 54465750353635314001e00100b00400 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=WALLPAPER_INVALID_FILE; exit 1; }\n' +
      'TF_HASH=$(sha256sum "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565"); TF_HASH=${TF_HASH%% *}\nprintf \'%s\\n\' "$TF_HASH" | grep -Eq \'^[a-f0-9]{64}$\' || exit 1\nTF_HASH=\\\"$TF_HASH\\\"\nfi\nprintf \'TOPFLOW_WALLPAPER_BACKUP={"sha256":%s,"bootId":"%s"}\\n\' "$TF_HASH" "$TF_BOOT"\n';
  }
  function wallpaperRestoreChecks(sha) {
    if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(sha || '')) throw error('INVALID_HASH', '壁纸校验信息无效');
    return 'if [ -e "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" ] || [ -L "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" ]; then\n' +
      '[ -f "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565")" = 0 ] && [ "$(stat -c %h "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565")" = 1 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=WALLPAPER_RESTORE_CONFLICT; exit 1; }\n' +
      'printf \'%s  %s\\n\' ' + shellQuote(sha) + ' "$TF_ROOT/lock-wallpaper.rgb565" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=WALLPAPER_RESTORE_CONFLICT; exit 1; }\nfi\n';
  }
  function buildWallpaperCommand(action, payload, sha, details) {
    if (!['status', 'prepare', 'chunk', 'commit', 'abort', 'clear'].includes(action)) throw error('INVALID_ACTION', '壁纸动作无效');
    if (action !== 'status' && !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(sha || '')) throw error('INVALID_HASH', '壁纸校验信息无效');
    if (action !== 'status') releaseAllowed(payload);
    var args = action === 'status' ? '' : ' --confirmed ' + shellQuote(sha);
    if (action !== 'status') {
      if (!details || !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(details.nonce || '') || !/^[a-f0-9]{8}-(?:[a-f0-9]{4}-){3}[a-f0-9]{12}$/.test(details.bootId || '')) throw error('INVALID_TRANSACTION', '壁纸事务信息无效');
      args += ' ' + shellQuote(details.nonce) + ' ' + shellQuote(details.bootId);
      if (action === 'chunk') {
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(details.offset) || details.offset < 0 || details.offset >= 307216 || typeof details.base64 !== 'string' || details.base64.length < 4 || details.base64.length > 32768 || !/^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/.test(details.base64)) throw error('INVALID_CHUNK', '壁纸分块信息无效');
        args += ' ' + String(details.offset) + ' ' + shellQuote(details.base64);
      }
    }
    nativePayload(payload);
    var migrating = details && details.migration === true && action !== 'status';
    return 'set -eu\n' + rootGuard() +
      '[ -d "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$TF_ROOT")" = "$TF_ROOT" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$TF_ROOT")" = 0 ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=UNSAFE_TARGET; exit 1; }\n' + screenOwnershipGuard(payload, null, migrating && action !== 'abort' ? sha : null, true) +
      '[ "$TF_VERSION_MISMATCH" = false ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=INSTALLED_VERSION_MISMATCH; exit 1; }\n' +
      '[ ! -e "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/.install-owner" ] && [ -f "$TF_ROOT/screenctl.sh" ] && [ ! -L "$TF_ROOT/screenctl.sh" ] || { echo TOPFLOW_ERROR=INSTALL_INCOMPLETE; exit 1; }\n' +
      'printf \'%s  %s\\n\' ' + shellQuote(payload.screenctlSha256) + ' "$TF_ROOT/screenctl.sh" | sha256sum -c -\n' +
      (migrating ? '(\nset -- wallpaper-' + action + args + '\n' + payload.screenctlSource.replace(/\n?$/, '\n') + ')\n' : 'sh "$TF_ROOT/screenctl.sh" wallpaper-' + action + args + '\n');
  }
  function parseScreenStatus(output) {
    var lines = String(output || '').split(/\r?\n/).filter(function (line) { return line.indexOf('TOPFLOW_SCREEN=') === 0; });
    if (lines.length !== 1) throw error('STATUS_UNCONFIRMED', '屏幕状态未确认');
    var state;
    try { state = JSON.parse(lines[0].slice(15)); } catch (_) { throw error('STATUS_UNCONFIRMED', '屏幕状态无效'); }
    if (!state || !['factory', 'custom', 'unknown'].includes(state.mode)) throw error('STATUS_UNCONFIRMED', '屏幕状态无效');
    var parsed = { installed: state.installed !== false, partial: state.partial === true, uploadActive: state.uploadActive === true, mode: state.mode, pid: Number.isSafeInteger(state.pid) ? state.pid : null, ready: state.ready === true, heartbeatAge: Number.isSafeInteger(state.heartbeatAge) && state.heartbeatAge >= 0 ? state.heartbeatAge : null, supervised: state.supervised === true };
    if (typeof state.failure === 'string' && /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,63}$/.test(state.failure)) parsed.failure = state.failure;
    if (parsed.failure && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rendererFailures, state.rendererFailure)) parsed.rendererFailure = state.rendererFailure;
    if (parsed.failure && Number.isInteger(state.rendererExitStatus) && state.rendererExitStatus >= 0 && state.rendererExitStatus <= 255) parsed.rendererExitStatus = state.rendererExitStatus;
    if (['FACTORY_INTERNAL_LOCK_ACTIVE', 'FACTORY_INTERNAL_LOCK_UNSTABLE', 'FACTORY_AUTOSLEEP_LOCK_ACTIVE'].includes(state.waiting)) parsed.waiting = state.waiting;
    if (Number.isSafeInteger(state.waitingRemaining) && state.waitingRemaining >= 0 && state.waitingRemaining <= 360) parsed.waitingRemaining = state.waitingRemaining;
    if (state.versionMismatch === true) parsed.versionMismatch = true;
    if (state.autostart && typeof state.autostart.enabled === 'boolean' && ['present', 'absent', 'conflict', 'unknown'].includes(state.autostart.hook) && ['disabled', 'enabled', 'waiting', 'starting', 'started', 'skipped', 'failed', 'cancelled'].includes(state.autostart.state)) {
      parsed.autostart = { enabled: state.autostart.enabled, hook: state.autostart.hook, state: state.autostart.state };
      if (typeof state.autostart.reason === 'string' && /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,63}$/.test(state.autostart.reason)) parsed.autostart.reason = state.autostart.reason;
    }
    return parsed;
  }
  var MAX_SHELL_COMMAND_BYTES = 96 * 1024;
  function shellCommandBytes(value) {
    var text = String(value), bytes = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      var code = text.charCodeAt(i);
      if (code < 128) bytes++;
      else if (code < 2048) bytes += 2;
      else if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff && i + 1 < text.length && text.charCodeAt(i + 1) >= 0xdc00 && text.charCodeAt(i + 1) <= 0xdfff) { bytes += 4; i++; }
      else bytes += 3;
    }
    return bytes;
  }
  function validateShellCommand(command) {
    var text = String(command), bytes = shellCommandBytes(text);
    if (bytes >= MAX_SHELL_COMMAND_BYTES) throw error('SHELL_COMMAND_TOO_LARGE', 'UFI Shell 命令超过安全长度（' + bytes + ' 字节），已在发送前停止；请更新插件，不会自动重试');
    return text;
  }
  function directRequest(root, path, options) {
    var base = typeof KANO_baseURL !== 'undefined' && KANO_baseURL ? KANO_baseURL : '/api';
    var url = new URL(String(base).replace(/\/$/, '') + path, root.location.href);
    if (url.origin !== root.location.origin) throw error('UNSAFE_API', 'UFI 接口必须与当前已登录面板同源');
    var headers = typeof common_headers !== 'undefined' && common_headers ? Object.assign({}, common_headers) : {};
    Object.keys(headers).forEach(function (key) { if (key.toLowerCase() === 'content-type') delete headers[key]; });
    if (options.json) headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    return root.fetch(url.href, { method: options.method || 'POST', headers: headers, credentials: 'same-origin', body: options.json ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : options.body });
  }
  function ownInstalledBlock(source, executingScript) {
    if (typeof source !== 'string' || typeof executingScript !== 'string' || executingScript.length < 100) return null;
    var blocks = /<!--\s*\[KANO_PLUGIN_START\]\s*(.*?)\s*-->([\s\S]*?)<!--\s*\[KANO_PLUGIN_END\]\s*\1\s*-->/g;
    var found = [], names = [], block;
    while ((block = blocks.exec(source))) {
      names.push(block[1].trim());
      var scripts = Array.from(block[2].matchAll(/<script(?:\s[^>]*)?>([\s\S]*?)<\/script\s*>/gi));
      if (scripts.length === 1 && scripts[0][1].trim() === executingScript.trim()) found.push({ name: block[1].trim(), remaining: source.slice(0, block.index) + source.slice(blocks.lastIndex) });
    }
    return found.length === 1 && found[0].name.length <= 160 && /\.txt$/i.test(found[0].name) && !/[\\/:\x00-\x1f]/.test(found[0].name) && !found[0].name.includes('..') && names.filter(function (name) { return name === found[0].name; }).length === 1 ? found[0] : null;
  }
  function findInstalledBlockName(source, executingScript) {
    var record = ownInstalledBlock(source, executingScript); return record && record.name;
  }
  async function removeInstalledRecord(root, executingScript) {
    async function readSource() {
      var response = await directRequest(root, '/get_custom_head', { method: 'GET' }), data = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok || !data || typeof data.text !== 'string') throw error('RECORD_UNCONFIRMED', 'UFI 插件记录读取未确认');
      return data.text;
    }
    var first = await readSource(), record = ownInstalledBlock(first, executingScript);
    if (!record) throw error('RECORD_AMBIGUOUS', '未能唯一识别本插件及真实导入名称，请使用 UFI 插件列表删除');
    var second = await readSource(), again = ownInstalledBlock(second, executingScript);
    if (first !== second || !again || again.name !== record.name) throw error('RECORD_CHANGED', '插件列表已变化，未调用删除接口；请刷新后重试');
    var response = await directRequest(root, '/plugin/uninstall', { json: true, body: { name: record.name } });
    var reply = await response.json().catch(function () { return null; });
    if (!response.ok || !reply || typeof reply !== 'object' || Array.isArray(reply) || reply.success === false || reply.result === 'error' || reply.error) throw error('RECORD_API_UNCONFIRMED', 'UFI 单条卸载接口不可用或响应未确认，请在插件列表删除“' + record.name + '”');
    var after = await readSource();
    if (ownInstalledBlock(after, executingScript) || after.trim() !== record.remaining.trim()) throw error('RECORD_REMOVE_UNCONFIRMED', '未回读到仅本插件记录被移除，请核对 UFI 插件列表；不会整表覆盖或自动重试');
    return { removed: true, name: record.name };
  }
  async function uploadNative(root, payload) {
    releaseAllowed(payload);
    nativePayload(payload);
    var binary = root.atob(payload.archiveBase64), bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    var form = new root.FormData();
    form.append('path', ROOT);
    form.append('file', new root.Blob([bytes], { type: 'application/gzip' }), '.payload.tar.gz');
    var response = await directRequest(root, '/upload_file', { body: form });
    var result = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok || result.result !== 'success' || result.path !== ROOT + '/.payload.tar.gz' || result.name !== '.payload.tar.gz' || result.size !== bytes.length) { var uploadError = error('UPLOAD_UNCONFIRMED', '归档上传未确认，不会解包或自动重试'); uploadError.uploadCompleted = true; throw uploadError; }
  }
  function readBridges(root) {
    return {
      runShellWithRoot: async function (command, timeout) {
        var response = await directRequest(root, '/run_shell', { json: true, body: { cmd: validateShellCommand(command), timeout: Number(timeout) || 12000 } });
        var result = await response.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
        if (!response.ok || result.success !== true || typeof result.content !== 'string') throw shellFailure(response, result);
        return result;
      }
    };
  }
  function register(root) {

    if (!doc || root.__topflow_screen_plugin) return;

    var executingScript = doc.currentScript && doc.currentScript.textContent || '';
    var controller = { close: closePanel, open: openPanel };

    var bridges = readBridges(root);
    var cancelTask = null, cancelRequested = false, cancelSignal = null, cancelWake = null, activeAction = '', stateEpoch = 0;

    }

    }

      var actions = { status: '读取中', switch: '切换中', uninstall: '卸载中', autostart: '设置中', cancel: '取消中' };
      panel.querySelector('[data-tf-state-label]').textContent = busy ? (actions[activeAction] || '处理中') : !state ? '等待确认' : state.failure ? '需要检查' : state.waiting ? '等待交接' : state.uploadActive ? '上传待确认' : state.partial ? '安装未完成' : mode === 'custom' ? '进程运行中' : mode === 'factory' ? '原厂运行中' : '状态未知';

'原厂继续运行，可随时取消本次等待。' : state.uploadActive ? '上传结果未确认，等待完成后再继续操作。' : state.partial ? '可清理已识别的未完成安装，再重新启用。' : mode === 'custom' ? '进程状态已读取，画面与触摸请在设备上确认。' : mode === 'factory' ? '原厂屏幕正在运行，插件组件按需启用。' : '请刷新状态，确认后再继续操作。';

    function say(text) { if (message) { message.textContent = text; if (message.parentElement && (activeAction !== 'status' || /失败|异常|未确认|未完成/.test(text))) message.parentElement.open = true; } }
    function updateButtons() {

      var bootReasons = { READY_TIMEOUT: '服务就绪超时', INTEGRITY_FAILED: '组件校验未通过', CONFIG_INVALID: '启动配置未确认', START_FAILED: '屏幕接管未确认', SCREEN_UNCONFIRMED: '屏幕运行尚未确认' };

'自启动状态未确认，请刷新' : ['conflict', 'unknown'].includes(boot.hook) ? '启动项状态异常，请刷新检查' : (boot.enabled || boot.state === 'failed' ? bootLabels[boot.state] : '已关闭') + (bootReasons[boot.reason] ? ' · ' + bootReasons[boot.reason] : '');
